mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE id = #{studentId}

SELECT a.id AS application_id, j.company_name, j.title, a.status, a.submitted_at, CAST(d.document AS CHAR) AS document FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = a.job_posting_id LEFT JOIN application_document d ON d.application_id = a.id WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT i.id AS item_id, j.company_name, j.title, i.response, i.pass_reason FROM recommendation_item i JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = i.job_posting_id LEFT JOIN application a ON a.recommendation_item_id = i.id WHERE a.id IS NULL AND i.recommendation_id = ( SELECT r.id FROM recommendation r WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY i.rank_no

SELECT a.id AS application_id, a.student_id, a.status, j.id AS job_posting_id, j.company_name, j.title, j.job_category, j.location, j.employment_type, j.career, j.education, j.description FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = a.job_posting_id WHERE a.id = #{applicationId}

SELECT id AS item_id, title, period_text, team_size, CAST(tech_stack AS CHAR) AS tech_stack, portfolio_file_url AS portfolio_file_name, include_in_apply, role_note, readme, source FROM student_project WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY id
SELECT a.id AS application_id, a.status, j.company_name FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = a.job_posting_id WHERE a.id = #{applicationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_document (application_id, document) VALUES (#{applicationId}, CAST(#{document} AS JSON)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE document = CAST(#{document} AS JSON)
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET status = #{to} WHERE id = #{applicationId} AND status = #{from}
